release_notes: Release v1.3.6: Modernized Vision OCR catalog to top Gemini 3.x models (Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.7 Flash, 3.5 Flash Lite, 3.1 Flash Lite, 3.6 Flash), enabled dynamic manuscript mode model switching (Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, 4 Argon, 3.8 Flash), enforced User Model Primacy, resolved cross-thread failover signal reference marshalling, and eliminated multimodal OpenRouter 404 parameter errors.
